description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests for the Calendar module in vtiger CRM, including rendering mini calendars, handling calendar settings, changing views, updating activity statuses, and fetching event and todo lists.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Class representing calendar views and operations in the Calendar module.

methods.name: calendar_layout
methods.description: Renders the calendar layout based on provided data.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Returns language strings for a specific module.

methods.name: getEventList
methods.description: Fetches list of events within a date range.

methods.name: constructEventListView
methods.description: Constructs HTML for event list view.

methods.name: getTodoList
methods.description: Fetches list of todos within a date range.

methods.name: constructTodoListView
methods.description: Constructs HTML for todo list view.

methods.name: checkFileAccessForInclusion
methods.description: Checks if a file can be included based on access rights.

methods.name: ChangeStatus
methods.description: Changes the status of an activity.

methods.name: getActivityMailInfo
methods.description: Retrieves email info related to an activity.
